entities.name: Trichosanthes and Cinnamon Twig Decoction (Gua Lou Gui Zhi Tang)

formula_attributes.dosage: Trichosanthes root 6 g, Cinnamon twig 9 g, Peony root 9 g, Licorice root 6 g, Fresh ginger 9 g, Jujube 12 pieces; take the six ingredients with 900 ml water, boil down to 300 ml, divide into three doses and take warm (to produce slight sweating).
formula_attributes.key_diagnostic_points: Used for externally contracted wind-cold with fever and aversion to wind, headache with sweating, body rigidity with slight convulsions, and a pulse that is deep, slow, and forceful.
